entities.summary: Göran Albert Casimir "Casse" Ehrnrooth, titled Vuorineuvos, was a Finnish magnate and former chairman of the Nokia Corporation. His business career began in the forest industry, and later he was a director of UPM-Kymmene and Merita-Nordbanken.
